cases.title: Subjects table filters: program, semester and year level combine, hide subjects without a term, and clear

checks.message: the unfiltered table lists every subject (3)
the subject count is shown
there is no academic year filter in the table: the page shows one year's catalog
there is exactly one Semester filter on the page (1)
semester + year level together find IT 306
a different semester hides it and the table says nothing matches
Clear filters brings every subject back
subjects without a term (and those of other levels) are hidden by a term filter
the program filter still works alongside the others

E19: no JavaScript console errors (none)
E19: no unexpected API failures (none)

at 375 px the filters wrap and the page has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 375 <= 375)
